purpose: Teach: プロダクション/自負/特長/館長/主語/一部分/コンセンサス/求む

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロダクション会社と業務提携を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with a partnership with the production company.
lines.style: Crisp, businesslike. Direct gaze. Clear articulation on each clause. Efficient energy — no extra breath. The tone of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の伝統に自負を持って臨みます
lines.en: Yes. We'll approach this with pride in our company's track record.
lines.style: Respectful alignment. Steady delivery. Slight emphasis on 「伝統」 — showing respect for the tradition. Measured pace. A nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品の特長を整理しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the key features of the new product.
lines.style: Purposeful, organizing-mode. Slight lean forward in the voice. Clear enunciation. The cadence of someone guiding a team through next steps.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。美術館長との対談企画も進めます
lines.en: Yes. We're also moving ahead with an interview feature with the museum director.
lines.style: Responsive update. Warm but professional. Quick intake of breath before starting — showing he was ready with this answer. Energized, not rushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案書の主語を統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's standardize the subjects in the proposal.
lines.style: Careful attention to detail. Precise articulation. Slower pace than before — this is about accuracy. The voice of someone who catches what others miss.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料の一部分を差し替えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll swap out sections of the materials.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Quick, assured delivery. No hesitation — he knows the task. Professional shorthand between colleagues who understand each other.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部内のコンセンサスを取りましょう
lines.en: Let's build consensus within the department.
lines.style: Thoughtful, diplomatic. Pause weight on 「コンセンサス」. Inclusive tone — we, not I. The careful phrasing of someone thinking about team dynamics.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中途採用「求む」の案内を出します
lines.en: Yes. I'll send out the recruitment notice for mid-career hires.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Assured, complete. Slight lift at the end — closing a checklist item. Professional, warm closure to the exchange.
